title: Gastrointestinal and hepatobiliary system
audience: a medical student in the preclinical years
purpose: Integrate GI anatomy, embryology and physiology, disorders of the esophagus and stomach, peptic ulcer and bleeding, malabsorption, inflammatory bowel disease, colorectal disease and cancer, liver tests, hepatitis and cirrhosis, the gallbladder and pancreas, GI infections and GI drugs.

weeks.2: GI physiology: motility, secretion and absorption
weeks.3: Disorders of the esophagus and stomach
weeks.4: Peptic ulcer disease and GI bleeding

blocks.deliverable: Explain the regulation of gastric acid secretion.
Outline the initial management of an upper GI bleed.
Compare Crohn disease and ulcerative colitis.
Week 7 midterm; classify a liver test pattern.
Explain the complications of cirrhosis and their management.
Submit the project; take an unseen 150 minute final in week 14.

project: Liver-test and GI-bleed workshop: interpret supplied liver panels and plan the initial management of an upper GI bleed step by step.
completion: finish the project, take the week 7 midterm and week 14 cumulative final, then complete a new cumulative assessment after 1 to 2 weeks. Explain one major idea aloud without notes.
